text:
Elena Park: quick heads-up — I need someone to take the rubric lead for the SRE candidate at 3pm PT tomorrow. I'm double booked with a release cutover. 45m interview, standard scribe + debrief within 24h. @Samir @Maya any availability?
Samir Patel: I can do rubric lead if Maya can scribe. traveling but will be online.
Maya K: I can scribe but can only join audio first 10m then hop to chat for notes. happy to capture decisions and scores.
Elena Park: that works. rubric lead = run the intro, pick 1 deep infra q, call time. scribe = capture two: summary + top risks.
Priya Rao: FYI ops: please set debrief window to 24h in the invite and attach the scorecard. Also add transcript permission.
Calendar Bot: Meeting updated — "SRE interview (45m)" 3:00pm PT tomorrow. Attendees: Elena Park, Samir Patel, Maya K, Priya Rao. Reminder set.
Samir Patel: quick rubric question — for 'system design tradeoffs' do we weight correctness vs. tradeoff reasoning equally? I thought we recently shifted to heavier on tradeoff explanation.
Maya K: good call. We adjusted last quarter: tradeoff reasoning = 40%, system correctness = 30%, communication = 20%, ownership = 10%. Use the new weights on the scorecard.
Elena Park: thanks — Samir, use the "Q2 infra rubric v2" checklist (linked in interview kit). If someone flags a regression in tone/communication, note it in the debrief notes.
Samir Patel: got it. one more — if candidate goes long on a whiteboard, do we still probe for ownership?
Maya K: yes — after the whiteboard, ask two ownership follow-ups: product impact & postmortem approach. Mark ownership in the quick anchors section.
Priya Rao: Ops checklist: Please make sure recording consent is confirmed at the start. If candidate declines, mark "no recording" and scribe a longer summary.
Elena Park: small ask — if either of you spots a scoring outlier (>=2 points diff on a category), ping me in this thread before submitting so we can normalize quickly.
Samir Patel: will do. also tagging @people-ops for ambient note: can we add a short link to the eval form in the calendar description? saves searching.
Priya Rao: adding now. link: https://redwood.work/evals/sre-q2-v2
Maya K: ok all set. I’ll scribe and capture timestamps for tricky answers. Samir you lead. Elena — thanks and good luck with the release cutover :rocket:
Elena Park: thanks team :heart: If anything changes, update the invite. Otherwise I’ll handle post-interview calibration if needed.
Samir Patel: thanks — will DM if we need backup.
Calendar Bot: Reminder sent 15 minutes before meeting."
